prompt: I'm setting up a Solid Pod for a citation management app I'm building. The Pod will be at https://pods.acme.org/alice/. I need to design a vocabulary for my app — I'll have classes for Citation, Author, Venue, and Journal, plus some predicates like `cites`, `affiliatedWith`. What should the vocabulary namespace IRI be, and where should I host the vocabulary file? Also, should I just use w3id.org for stability? Give me a concrete plan with example Turtle for the vocabulary file.

assertions.name: recommends_pod_hosted_vocab
assertions.description: Recommends hosting the vocabulary on the Pod itself, not on w3id.org
assertions.check: answer recommends a namespace IRI under pods.acme.org and explains Pod-as-namespace-authority OR explicitly argues against w3id.org for per-app vocab

assertions.name: uses_hash_namespace
assertions.description: Namespace IRI ends with `#` (hash URI pattern, not slash + 303)
assertions.check: the recommended namespace IRI ends with `#`

assertions.name: https_no_port_no_extension
assertions.description: Recommended namespace uses https, no port, no .ttl extension in the IRI
assertions.check: namespace starts with https://, contains no `:NNNN`, contains no `.ttl` before the `#`

assertions.name: mnemonic_class_names
assertions.description: Example Turtle uses mnemonic class names (Citation, Author, Venue, Journal) not opaque IDs
assertions.check: example Turtle shows classes named Citation/Author/Venue/Journal as IRIs

assertions.name: addresses_w3id_question_correctly
assertions.description: Engages with the w3id question and explains when to use it (cross-Pod shared) vs not (per-app)
assertions.check: answer mentions w3id.org and gives a clear yes/no with reasoning, not generic 'it depends'

assertions.name: includes_example_turtle
assertions.description: Provides example Turtle showing @prefix and at least 2 class declarations
assertions.check: answer contains `@prefix` and `a owl:Class` (or rdfs:Class) for the example types
